name: What finishes are available after widening a doorway?

mainEntity.name: What finishes are available after widening a doorway?

acceptedAnswer.text: After widening a doorway, various finishing options are available to seamlessly integrate the new opening with your home's existing aesthetic. This typically includes matching the surrounding drywall texture and paint color. You can also choose new door frames, casings, and trim to complement your interior design. For a modern look, some prefer a clean, frameless opening. We work with you to select finishes that meet your style preferences and budget, ensuring a cohesive look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finishes after doorway widening include matching drywall and paint, new door frames, casings, trim, or frameless options to match your home's aesthetic.
